import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int MAXE = 400005;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int SRC = 501;
    static final int SNK = 502;

    static char[][] gridA = new char[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1];
    static int[][] safeDist = new int[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1];
    static int[] moveX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] moveY = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, fl, c, nxt;
        Edge(int u, int v, int fl, int c, int nxt) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.fl = fl;
            this.c = c;
            this.nxt = nxt;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXE + 1];
    static int edgeCnt = 0;
    static int[] head = new int[505];
    static int[] parentEdge = new int[505];
    static int[] seen = new int[505];
    static int[] depth = new int[505];
    static int answer = 0;

    static int id(int x, int y, int n) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    static int getX(int code, int n) {
        return (code - 1) / n + 1;
    }

    static int getY(int code, int n) {
        return (code - 1) % n + 1;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        e[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(u, v, 0, cap, head[u]);
        head[u] = edgeCnt;
        e[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edgeCnt;
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Queue<Integer> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        qu.add(SRC);
        seen[SRC] = 1;
        depth[SRC] = 1;
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qu.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].nxt) {
                int y = e[i].v;
                if (seen[y] == 0 && e[i].fl < e[i].c) {
                    parentEdge[y] = i;
                    seen[y] = 1;
                    depth[y] = depth[x] + 1;
                    qu.add(y);
                    if (y == SNK) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int x, int now) {
        if (x == SNK || now == 0) return now;
        int rest = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = e[i].nxt) {
            int y = e[i].v;
            if (e[i].c > e[i].fl && depth[y] == depth[x] + 1) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(y, Math.min(rest, e[i].c - e[i].fl));
                if (pushed == 0) depth[y] = 0;
                e[i].fl += pushed;
                e[((i - 1) ^ 1) + 1].fl -= pushed;
                rest -= pushed;
                if (rest == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return now - rest;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            answer += sendFlow(SRC, INF);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize safeDist
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(safeDist[i], 10000);
        }

        Queue<Integer> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();

        // Read gridA and set up source edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfsQueue.add(id(i, j, n));
                    safeDist[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(SRC, id(i, j, n), gridA[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for safeDist from 'Z' cells
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int code = bfsQueue.poll();
            int x = getX(code, n);
            int y = getY(code, n);
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + moveX[d];
                int ny = y + moveY[d];
                if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= n && ny <= n &&
                    gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' && safeDist[nx][ny] > safeDist[x][y] + 1) {
                    safeDist[nx][ny] = safeDist[x][y] + 1;
                    bfsQueue.add(id(nx, ny, n));
                }
            }
        }

        // For each digit cell in gridA, compute distances and add edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > '9') continue;
                int start = id(i, j, n);
                // 2D distance array for this start
                int[][] dist = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[k], 10000);
                }
                bfsQueue.clear();
                bfsQueue.add(start);
                dist[i][j] = 0;
                while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
                    int code = bfsQueue.poll();
                    int x = getX(code, n);
                    int y = getY(code, n);
                    for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                        int nx = x + moveX[f];
                        int ny = y + moveY[f];
                        if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= n && ny <= n &&
                            gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                            dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1 &&
                            dist[x][y] < safeDist[x][y]) {
                            dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                            bfsQueue.add(id(nx, ny, n));
                        }
                    }
                }
                // Add edges from start to second layer nodes
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        if (dist[k][l] <= Math.min(safeDist[k][l], timeLimit)) {
                            addEdge(start, id(k, l, n) + 100, 10000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Read gridB and add edges to sink
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (gridB[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id(i, j, n) + 100, SNK, gridB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        dinic();
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
